job_id.description: The job ID used to process this request.

error.description: Error message if the agent failed.

hostname.description: Hostname of the agent that produced this result.

status.description: What happened on the host: ok, the operation ran and succeeded; failed, it ran and did not succeed; skipped, the host's OS family does not support it; timeout, the host did not answer, so nobody knows whether it ran.
status.title: RowStatus

200.description: Each target host's result, with whether it changed.

error.description: A description of the error that occurred.

reason.description: Why the request failed, as a word that a program can branch on. The HTTP status is the class of the problem; the reason is the cause, and the error is the message for a person, which can change between releases. invalid_request: the request breaks a rule, such as a missing field (400). unauthorized: no token, or a token that is not valid (401). forbidden: the token does not have the permission (403). not_found: the host or osapi does not have what the request names (404). not_managed: the item is there, but osapi did not deploy it, so osapi does not change it (409). not_installed: the host does not have a program that the request needs (409). conflict: the state of the item blocks the request, such as a create of one that exists (409). unavailable: a part that osapi depends on is down, such as NATS (503). job_store_full: the job store is at its max_bytes and has no finished job to remove (503). server_error: the controller failed; its log has the cause (500).
